welcome.title: Experience Hergla Park before you even arrive
welcome.heroDesc: Explore our world of leisure, speed, and thrill in full 3D immersion directly from your web browser.
welcome.subtitle: Discover our entire park in 3D immersion directly in your browser. A virtual trip to adrenaline.

features.title: An Innovative Digital Experience
features.subtitle: Designed to let you explore the park as if you were already there
features.f1Desc: Explore every corner of the park directly from your browser, no download needed.
features.f2Desc: Keyboard and mouse controls for immediate ease of use, even for first-timers.
features.f3Desc: Accessible for all guests aged 7+, on tablet, computer, or VR headsets.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.subtitle: 3 simple steps to start your virtual walkthrough
howItWorks.h1Desc: Discover the flight controls and safety guidelines.
howItWorks.h2Desc: Click the launch button and step into the 3D world.
howItWorks.h3Desc: Freely navigate through every zone and track in Hergla Park.

cta.title: Ready to dive into the experience?
cta.desc: Discover our professional kart tracks, leisure spaces, and all the magic of Hergla Park.

controls.title: Take Control of Your Immersion
controls.subtitle: Familiarize yourself with the navigation and interaction controls to explore Hergla Park like you are physically there.
controls.moveText: W/A/S/D (or Z/Q/S/D) to move around in the virtual world.
controls.interactText: E key to interact (hop into a kart, order from the café).
controls.interactDesc: Use this key to confirm your selections or interact with objects.
